items.summary: Kyverno 1.16.0 through 1.19.1 fails to validate path segments in the resource argument of resource.get() and resource.post(), letting namespaced CEL policies escape their namespace. Published November 5; upgrade to Kyverno 1.19.2 or later.

A use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP request-socket handling, present since kernel 4.4, lets a remote unauthenticated attacker reach remote code execution; Anthropic demonstrated a remote-root exploit against multipath TCP listeners. Red Hat shipped fixed kernels November 1; Ubuntu fixes are in its testing channel.

PHP's use of longjmp() for out-of-memory errors can be abused for remote code execution (PHP2Shell), confirmed exploited in the wild against internet-facing PAN-OS management interfaces and chained with a Linux kernel flaw to reach root. Patch PHP and restrict management-plane access.

A Linux kernel flaw in how virtio-net handles IPv4 checksum metadata lets an untrusted VM guest overwrite two bytes of an already-validated IPv4 header on the host, escaping the guest. The bug dates to kernel 2.6.27; CloudLinux has livepatches on its main feed and kernel updates are rolling out.

Adobe Commerce and Magento are affected by an unrestricted upload of a file with a dangerous type, rated CVSS 9.3, with exploitation tracked since March 2026 across hundreds of stores. Apply Adobe's security update and audit storefront uploads.
